snippet.title: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens - Official Release Window Trailer
snippet.description:
Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens will be released in Q4 2026 for PC.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2249060/Edenfall_Legacy_of_the_First_Wardens/

Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens is a single-player action adventure set in a charming, hand-crafted environment. Players will play as Venya, a young shapeshifting heroine, on her journey through a whimsical world. Eden has been overrun by evil creatures. Now Venya’s task is to drive them out and restore peace. Venya discovers her people's past and uncovers her magical abilities, including the power to transform into animals.

Developer: Everflux Games
X: https://x.com/everfluxgames
